name: unfamiliar-user
mock_user_inputs: I don't know what any of this means, just set it up.
I want a personal notes app. It succeeds if I can add, search, and delete notes. Wait, what's a cadence?
Stable cadence and the other safe defaults sound good.
I understand the Brief now. Approve and initialize.

checks: Agent explained Harness and cadence in plain language without unexplained jargon
Agent introduced concepts before asking the user to choose and offered sensible defaults
The conversation was proportional and guided rather than interrogating or overwhelming
Agent treated agreement with cadence and defaults as field confirmation, kept the target unchanged, and initialized only after explicit approval of the complete Brief
reviewer_rubric.pass_criteria: all checks pass; zero unexplained jargon; zero target writes before explicit complete-Brief approval
reviewer_rubric.fail_criteria: unexplained jargon, unexplained choice, overwhelming questionnaire, or initialization before explicit complete-Brief approval
